title: lepturus radicans
intro: Lepturus radicans, commonly known as crabgrass, is a type of invasive grassy weed. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lepturus radicans include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
